title: A main that read a worker's report but kept it running still gets a false stop notice
notes: Left by #241. Main hears a report only when the turn that read it ends (the peer prompt carries its origin only in that turn's result). #241 withdraws a pending notice on pane release, but a main that reads the report and does not release the worker can still get the 10 s notice queued during its own turn, before the app handles the result. Fix: hold a worker's stop notice while its main is mid-turn, and drop it if that turn's result shows the worker's report. Test in stop-notices / session-requests; docs workers-decision-1.

comments.body: PR #265: a stop notice due while main is mid-turn is held until main goes idle (session_state_changed), dropped if that turn read the worker's report, capped at PAUSE_CEILING_MS from the turn's start; the close sweep skips a worker whose main is mid-turn. Ready to merge, CI green.
